out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed red sauce in a large metal pot being stored on the floor of the kitchen. The sauce was placed there to cool down.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PLEASE MAKE SURE THAT FOODS ARE NEVER STORED ON THE FLOOR. ALL FOODS MUST BE STORED AT LEAST 6 INHCES OFF THE FLOOR. PLEASE REMOVE ALL FOOD OFF THE FLOORS BY TIME OF NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Storage Clean and Dry Location
violations.observation: A large metal pot containing cooked noodles was being stored uncovered under the water pipes of the 3 vat sink.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food in a clean, dry location. PLEASE MAKE SURE TO ONLY STORE FOODS IN CLEAN AND DRY LOCATIONS. PLEASE REMOVE ALL FOODS FROM UNDER THE 3 VAT SINK BY TIME OF NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. Employee left kitchen to go to the bathroom and back and did not wash their hands or change their gloves. Employee began washing his hands with the gloves still on.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EHS EXPLAINED TO THE PIC THAT ANYTIME SOMEONE USES THE BATHROOM, ONCE THEY ENTER THE KITCHEN, THEY MUST WASH THEIR HANDS AGAIN IMMEDIATELY ONCE BACK IN THE KITCHEN. EHS ALSO EXPLAINED TO THE PIC THAT GLOVES CANNOT BE WASHED AS IF YOU ARE WASHING YOUR HANDS. EMPLOYEE WASHED HANDS PROPERLY.

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in a food preparation sink, warewashing sink or in a mop sink. After hand soap was purchased from the store, all employees needed to wash their hands. Multiple employees began washing their hands in the 3 vat sink.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. EHS EXPLAINED TO PIC AND EMPLOYEES THAT YOU CAN ONLY WASH YOUR HANDS IN A HAND WASHING SINK AMD CAN NEVER WASH THEM IN THE 3 VAT SINK. EMPLOYEES STOPPED WASHING THEIR HANDS IN THE SINK.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at all inside the facility at time of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. EHS EXPLAINED TO PIC THAT THE FACILITY MUST ALWAYS HAVE HAND SOAP IN ORDER TO PROPERLY WASH HANDS BEFORE, DURING AND AFTER FOOD PREPARATION. PIC HAD EMPLOYEE RUN TO STORE ACROSS THE PARKING LOT AND PIC UP HAND SOAP. ONCE THE HAND SOAP WAS AT THE FACILITY, EHS HAD ALL EMPLOYEES WASH THEIR HANDS AND CHANGE THEIR GLOVES. THAI GHANG WAAN (Inspection Date: 03/19/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw chicken and raw squid were being stored above multiple ready to eat items such as beansprouts, basil and other vegetables in the 2DR UPR Avantco cooler in the BOH.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT RAW FOODS MUST NEVER BE STORED ABOVE READY TO EAT FOODS TO HELP PREVENT TO POTENTIAL SPREAD OF BACTERIA. PIC HAD EMPLOYEE REARRANGE THE COOLER SO ALL RAW FOODS WERE AT THE BOTTOM.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: whole frozen ducks were sitting in a pot at room temperature to thaw.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THE 3 PROPER WAYS OF THAWING FOODS. 1) COOKING THE FOODS STRAIGHT FROM A FROZEN STATE, 2) MOVING THE FOOD ITEM FROM THE FREEZER TO THE FRIDGE UNTIL IT IS THAW AND 3) PLACE THE FOOD ITEM UNDER CONTINUOUSLY RUNNING WATER IN A PREP SINK AT A TEMPERATURE OF 70 DEGREES OR BELOW. PIC CHOSE TO RUN WATER OVER THE FROZEN DUCK AT 70F OR LOWER.

violations.title: Food Storage Prohibited under Sewer Lines
violations.observation: Produce was being stored under the hand sink while it was in the process of being cut.
violations.corrective_action: Food may not be stored under sewer lines that are not shielded to intercept potential drips. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT FOOD CAN NEVER BE STORED UNDER SEWER LINES. PIC HAD EMPLOYEE MOVE THE PRODUCE TO A BETTER AND SAFER LOCATION.

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The 2025 Health Department Permit was not posted.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. PLEASE POST A COPY OF THE 2025 HEALTH DEPARTMENT PERMIT IN VIEW OF THE GENERAL PUBLIC.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PLEASE MAKE SURE TO ALWAYS PROVIDE HAND SOAP AT EACH HAND SINK IN FACILITY. PIC WAS ANLE TO PROVIDE A NEW BOTTLE OF HAND SOAP FOR EHS.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: No hand washing sink in facility has proper handwashing signage.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. PLEASE MAKE SURE TO PROVIDE “HANDWASHING SINK ONLY” SIGNS AT EACH HAND WASHING SINK BY TIME OF NEXT INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Required
violations.observation: The food establishment's Permit to Operate is no longer valid due to expiration of the permit. No person shall operate a food establishment unless that person possesses a valid permit issued by the Health Department.
violations.corrective_action: To obtain a current Permit to Operate, contact the Health Department at (703) 246-2201 within 48 hours to make payment of the permit renewal fee. You may provide payment by cash, check, or credit card. Failure to pay the permit renewal fee and obtain a current Permit to Operate within 48 hours may lead to further enforcement actions by the Health Department including immediate closure. CDI permit renewal submitted during time of inspection.

violations.title: Cleaning Procedure
violations.observation: Observed food employees using improper handwashing procedures. PIC washed hands without soap or paper towels after touching blood from raw meat bag.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wash their hands and exposed portions of their arms by: 1) discarding used gloves; 2) rinsing under warm running water; 3) applying soap; 4) rubbing together for at least 10-15 seconds; 5) rinsing thoroughly under warm running water; and 6) drying with paper towels or air drying device. CDI Ehs demonstrated proper hand washing. Hands were washed correctly.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. CDI soap provided

violations.title: Food Contact Surface, 4 Hour Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed cutting boards/knives, rice spoon located at the kitchen that are not being cleaned at least every 4 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils must be cleaned and sanitized at least every 4 hours to prevent contamination by bacterial growth. CDI sanitizer sink set up and items sanitized. Drain plugs were missing

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: tofu, bean sprouts, rice noodles sitting on counter or on top of coolers and above 50f.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI food discarded. Discussed making space for these items in prep tops and removing some non tcs items instead. Discussed time control for tofu

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: rice, curry, and noodles not date marked
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CDI dates added.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): tofu left on counter without time marking.
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. violations.title: Miscellaneous Source Contamination
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were found subject to contamination after receipt and during storage due to the condition as described: food prep station with cutting board located adjacent to hand sink without splash guards to protect area from hand sink splash and contamination
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 through 3-306. Install splash guards

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: rice spoons stored in water and ice scoop handle stored touching ice for consumption.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CDI utensils stored properly
